name: Outstanding Tiny Desk
tagline: Put yourself, your friends or your pets into the viral Outstanding Tiny Desk meme with AI.
description: A fan-made AI parody maker for the Outstanding Tiny Desk meme (not affiliated with NPR). Upload 1-5 photos or one group photo and the AI seats everyone in the band; empty seats get made-up strangers, and there is a pets mode. The result is a 15-second vertical MP4 with the original live sound and no watermark, made in any phone browser. Paid, from $9.90, no free trial.
